items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and SEPA bank transfers. For Polish customers, we also support Przelewy24 and BLIK. All payments are processed securely through Stripe.

items.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
items.answer: Yes! We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all new customers. If you are not satisfied with our services within the first 14 days, contact our support team for a full refund.

items.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from the billing dashboard. When upgrading, you will be charged the prorated difference. Downgrades take effect at the next billing cycle.

items.question: What is the difference between shared and dedicated CPU?
items.answer: Shared CPU VPS instances share processor resources with other customers on the same host, which is cost-effective for most workloads. Dedicated CPU VPS instances have CPU cores exclusively reserved for your use, providing consistent performance for CPU-intensive applications.

items.question: Do you offer custom configurations?
items.answer: Yes! For dedicated servers and enterprise requirements, we offer custom configurations. Contact our sales team at hello@giveme.cloud to discuss your specific needs.

items.question: How is bandwidth measured?
items.answer: Bandwidth is measured as outbound (egress) traffic only. Inbound traffic is always free and unlimited. Unused bandwidth does not roll over to the next month.

items.question: What happens if I exceed my bandwidth limit?
items.answer: If you approach your bandwidth limit, we will notify you. You can either upgrade your plan or purchase additional bandwidth at €0.01/GB. We never suspend services without warning.

items.question: Do you provide invoices for VAT?
items.answer: Yes, we provide VAT invoices for all business customers. EU businesses with a valid VAT ID can receive invoices with reverse charge. Polish businesses receive invoices with 23% VAT included.

story.content: Founded in Poland, Giveme Cloud was built on a simple belief: European businesses deserve cloud infrastructure that respects their data, offers transparent pricing, and provides exceptional performance without the complexity of hyperscaler platforms.
